title: Cephi MCP servers
description: %APPDATA%\Cephi\mcp.json – MCP servers whose tools Cephi can use. Same format as Claude Desktop, so existing snippets can be pasted. Changes apply immediately.

server.description: Either a local server (command) or a remote one (url).

command.description: Program that starts the server, e.g. "npx", "uvx", "docker" or a path.

env.description: Environment variables. API keys: "{{secret:name}}" (stored under Keys, never in this file).

permission.description: confirm = every call asks first. auto = calls run without asking.

autoApprove.description: Tools that run without asking even with permission "confirm" (e.g. read-only ones).
